title: Pure Code Talker
summary: Pure Code Talker Link-climbing build with the hand-link Code monsters, Cynet Codec, and attribute-filling Cyberse extenders. Each Main Deck Code monster can be used as Link Material straight from the hand for a Code Talker and triggers a bonus effect when sent to the GY, chaining Attribute searches through Cynet Codec.

summary.title: Starters
points: Micro Coder (DARK) links from the hand for a Code Talker to search any Cynet Spell/Trap (starting with Cynet Codec or Cynet Conflict), or searches a Level 4 Cyberse if used from the field.

Code Generator (EARTH), Code Radiator (WATER), and Code Exporter (WIND) also link from the hand: Generator mills or adds a 1200 or less ATK Cyberse (such as Dotscaper), Radiator zeroes and negates an opposing monster, and Exporter recycles or revives a Level 4 or lower Cyberse.

Dotscaper revives itself when sent to the GY or banished, Flame Bufferlo (FIRE) discards a Cyberse to draw 2 when it leaves the field, and Backup Secretary (LIGHT) Special Summons itself while you control a Cyberse.

summary.title: Opening: Cynet Codec Attribute Chain
steps: Summon any Cyberse and use Micro Coder from the hand to Link Summon the DARK Link-2 Code Talker; Micro Coder searches Cynet Codec.
Activate Cynet Codec, then Link Summon Transcode Talker (EARTH): Codec searches Code Generator (EARTH), and Transcode revives Code Talker to a co-linked zone.

Link Summon Code Talker Inverted (LIGHT) or Excode Talker (WIND) using Code Generator from the hand: Codec searches Backup Secretary (LIGHT) or Code Exporter (WIND), while Generator sends Dotscaper to the GY to revive itself.
Climb into Decode Talker Heatsoul (FIRE), Allied Code Talker @Ignister, or Firewall Dragon Singularity, setting Cynet Conflict when Micro Coder is used again.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Transcode Talker revives a Link-3 or lower Cyberse and makes itself and its co-linked monsters untargetable (note: its effect locks you into Special Summoning only Cyberse monsters for the entire turn).
Accesscode Talker gains 1000 ATK times a Link material's Rating and banishes Link Monsters of different Attributes from the GY to destroy opposing cards without response.
Decode Talker Integration (the newest Link-3) sends a Cyberse from the Extra Deck to the GY and attacks twice, while Decode Talker Heatsoul pays 1000 LP on either turn to draw 1 card.

Allied Code Talker @Ignister (Link-5) revives multiple 2300 ATK Cyberses and Tributes a linked monster for an omni-negate, and Firewall Dragon Singularity (Link-6) bounces opposing cards as a Quick Effect.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Cynet Codec searches a Cyberse monster of the matching Attribute from the Deck for each of the six Attributes (DARK, EARTH, WATER, WIND, LIGHT, FIRE) whenever a Code Talker is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck.
Cynet Optimization grants an extra Cyberse Normal Summon and stops opponent activations during Code Talker battles.

Cynet Conflict is a searchable Counter Trap that negates and banishes any Spell, Trap, or monster effect while you control a Code Talker, and Recoded Alive banishes a Link-3 Cyberse to cheat out a Code Talker.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Protectcode Talker and Splash Mage are Forbidden in the TCG, and the page's Firewall and Mathmech starter sub-engines are omitted to keep the Main Deck focused on the Code Talker core.
